description: Bootstrap settings of the database, used when the CNPG cluster is initialized with `initdb`.

dataChecksums.description: Whether to enable data checksums when the database is initialized.

encoding.description: Encoding of the database, for example `UTF8`.

localeCollate.description: Collation order of the database locale, for example `C`.

localeCtype.description: Character classification of the database locale, for example `C`.

walSegmentSize.description: Size of the WAL segments in MB, between 1 and 1024.

postInitSQL.description: SQL statements to run after initialization, in the `postgres` database.

postInitApplicationSQL.description: SQL statements to run after initialization, in the application database.

postInitTemplateSQL.description: SQL statements to run after initialization, in the `template1` database.
